title: UFOs seen cleaning up radiation at Fukushima and Chernobyl

tellings.quote: And in both cases, people see the UFOs come down and seemingly clean up the radiation.

plain: After the nuclear disasters at Chernobyl in 1986 and Fukushima in 2011, people reportedly saw UFOs come down and seem to clean up the radiation. Michels tells it himself, citing the scholar Jensine Andresen, without naming the witnesses. If true, it would suggest UFOs take an interest in, and even repair, nuclear harm.
